description: This file contains C source code implementing tar archive handling, including functions for writing tar blocks, headers, extended headers, filtering archives, and integration with compression (gzip). It also manages configuration settings for tar filters and archivers, and handles the creation of tar archives with support for extended headers and compression filters.

classes.name: struct archiver
classes.description: Represents an archive handler with associated functions and settings.

classes.name: struct archiver_args
classes.description: Provides arguments needed for archiving operations, including repository info, time, compression level, and object IDs.

classes.name: struct ustar_header
classes.description: Represents the USTAR header structure used in tar archives.

classes.name: struct gz_header_s
classes.description: GZIP header structure for gzip compression.

classes.name: struct child_process
classes.description: Defines the process structure used to manage subprocesses for filtering commands.
